title: A Leading Global Meeting Destination: Why Brazil Is Competing, and Winning, on the World Stage
summary: For years, Brazil has been known for iconic beaches, vibrant culture, and unforgettable hospitality. Today, it is earning equal recognition for its growing leadership as one of the world's premier destinations for international meetings, incentives, conferences, and events.

title: Greater Fort Lauderdale: The New Blueprint for Large-Scale Meetings
summary: Today's attendees want more than convention halls and breakout rooms — they want destinations that feel immersive, accessible, and memorable. Greater Fort Lauderdale is answering that demand with a model that blends convention-scale infrastructure with a highly walkable, waterfront experience.

title: Detroit Gives Planners Room to Think Bigger
summary: When planners are looking to create standout meetings, flexibility can be just as valuable as square footage. That's where Detroit sets itself apart.

title: Bellagio’s Next Chapter: Timeless Luxury, Thoughtfully Reimagined
summary: Some destinations earn iconic status. Few continue to redefine it. At Bellagio, luxury is not a legacy—it is a living, evolving experience.

title: Where Business Meets Influence: Hosting in “Wall Street South”
summary: The Palm Beaches are rapidly emerging as a hub for finance, innovation, and executive leadership.

title: This Week on the Convene Podcast: Learning as an Art Form and Navigating a More Uncertain Global Meetings Landscape
summary: From how educators are using creative expression to transform learning at conferences, to what geopolitics, travel disruptions, and rising costs mean for the future of global meetings — here’s what’s new on the Convene Podcast.

title: Nueva Generación en la Industria de Reuniones –MICE-: Jóvenes que transforman la industria
summary: La nueva generación no solo recibe la antorcha: tiene la responsabilidad de fortalecerla y llevarla más lejos. Descubre cómo la formación, mentoría y nuevas oportunidades están impulsando el futuro de la industria de reuniones –MICE-.

title: Customer Advisory Summit -CAS- Los Cabos 2026: Caso de Éxito de ocho años de colaboración y aprendizaje
summary: Después de ocho años, el Customer Advisory Summit de Los Cabos que resulta de la colaboración entre PCMA y FITURCA demuestra que escuchar, contrastar perspectivas y dar seguimiento puede transformar una conversación en estrategia y en resultados para un destino.

title: El White Space en la industria de reuniones: tiempo de calidad, bienestar y equilibrio
summary: En una industria dedicada a organizar cada minuto, también necesitamos aprender a reservar espacios para nosotros. El white space no es tiempo que sobra, sino tiempo de calidad que elegimos para respirar, conectar y simplemente ser.

title: Fred Dixon Departs Brand USA to Lead NYC Tourism + Conventions
summary: NYC Tourism + Conventions has appointed Fred Dixon as president and CEO, marking a return to the organization he previously led for a decade.
